settings.heading: Light therapy that fits your routine
settings.text: Everything you need for red light therapy at home, in one comfortable, cordless cap.

settings.title: 291 red + near-infrared LEDs
settings.text: 97 red (660nm) and 194 near-infrared (850nm) LEDs spread across the inside of the cap.

settings.title: Cordless & rechargeable
settings.text: Built-in 2000mAh battery. No cable while you wear it: move around, read, work or unwind.

settings.title: 30 minutes, then it beeps
settings.text: One session a day. The cap beeps when your 30 minutes are up, so there's nothing to time.

settings.title: 4 modes, 3 brightness levels
settings.text: Choose Normal, Breathing, 10Hz or 40Hz pulse, and set the brightness that feels right.

settings.title: Looks like a regular cap
settings.text: Baseball-cap style in Black or Grey. Once it's on, the lights aren't visible from outside.

settings.title: Drug-free & mess-free
settings.text: Nothing to swallow, nothing to rub in, and no residue left in your hair.

settings.title: Charge it
settings.text: A full charge takes about 2 hours with the included cable and wall adapter, and lasts about an hour of use.

settings.title: Put it on & press start
settings.text: Wear it on a clean, dry scalp. Pick a mode and brightness with the button on the side.

settings.title: 30 minutes, once a day
settings.text: Relax while it works. The cap beeps at 30 minutes. Repeat daily. Consistency matters most.

settings.heading: A routine, not a miracle
settings.text: Here's what a realistic journey looks like. Everyone is different, and results vary from person to person.

settings.title: Build the habit
settings.text: Pick a time for your daily 30 minutes (morning coffee, evening TV) and stick to it.

settings.title: Stay consistent
settings.text: Keep up your routine. This is where most people give up too early.

settings.title: Check your progress
settings.text: Compare with photos from day one to see how your hair is looking.

settings.heading: Try it for 30 days. Love it or get your money back.
settings.text: Light therapy takes consistency, so give it a real try. If you're not happy within 30 days of delivery, email us and we'll refund you.

settings.question: How often should I use the Hair Renew Cap?
settings.answer: Once a day for 30 minutes. The cap beeps when your session is done. Consistency matters most, so pick a time that fits your day.

settings.question: When will I see results?
settings.answer: Red light therapy is a long-term routine, not an overnight fix. Most people use it consistently for several months before judging results, and results vary from person to person. That's why you get 30 days to try it risk-free.

settings.question: Is it for men or women?
settings.answer: Both. The Hair Renew Cap is a one-size baseball-style cap for anyone who wants to add red light therapy to their routine.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Most orders arrive in about 6–11 days, and every order is tracked. Your estimated delivery dates are shown next to the Add to cart button.

settings.question: What if it's not for me?
settings.answer: You have 30 days from delivery to try it. If you're not happy, email support@thedailyglowco.com for a full refund. See our Returns & Refunds page for details.
